items.title: The Lakers as a $12.5 Billion Tax Shelter
items.summary: In early August, former  Walt Disney  CEO Bob Iger and investor Josh Kushner bought a majority stake in the Los Angeles Lakers at a record $12.5 billion valuation—$2.5 billion more than the sale price a year ago.  Another is not-so-obvious: tax benefits.  Since 2004, pro franchises have been considered “Section 197 intangibles,” says tax expert Robert Willens.
